grammar.summary: 本课学习 too/very/enough 修饰形容词与考试场景。

points.title: too...to 结构
points.explanation: too + 形容词表"太……而不能"，常接 to do：The test was too difficult for me. 隐含"所以没考好"。

examples.en: The questions were too difficult for me.
examples.cn: 这些题对我来说太难了。

points.title: how about 表提议
points.explanation: How about + 名词/动名词？= ……怎么样？口语提议句型：How about the English test?
